_comment: Empathize action board lines (NPCEmpathize.Help): Help, Games, Romance and Talk. Player lines by speaker voice (default, em, bubba); replies by who they answer (default, toEm, toBubba).

default: Hold still, {name}. {Let me see to that|I have something for this}.
You are hurt. {Here|Take this}, it will help.
Sit down a moment, {name}. I will patch you up.
em: Hold still. I am fixing you, and I do not do this for everyone.
You are bleeding on my time, {name}. Allow me.
bubba: Madonna, look at you. Sit, sit, I got something for that.
Easy, darlin'. Bubba's got a {rag|kit} for everything.

default: {Thank you|Thanks}. {That is much better|I owe you one}.
Oh, that helps. {Really|It really does}.
I did not expect anyone to stop. Thank you.
toEm: From you? I will not forget it.
Thank you. You are kinder than they say.
toBubba: Grazie, big man. That is much better.
You have gentle hands for a mechanic. Thanks.

default: You look unwell, {name}. {Take this|Try this}, it is {item}.
I have {item} here. It should help with that.
That does not sound good. {Here|Take this}: {item}.
em: {item}. Take it. Do not argue with a goddess about dosage.
You are ill and it offends me. Here, {item}.
bubba: Here, {item}. My nonna swore by it. The pharmacy too.
Take this, guaglio', {item}. Twice a day, like the priest says.

default: I could not afford {item}. Thank you.
I will take it. {Thank you|Bless you}.
You did not have to do that. Thank you.
toEm: Medicine from a goddess. I will take it, thank you.
I will do as you say. Thank you.
toBubba: Grazie, Bubba. I feel better already.
You are a good man. Thank you.

default: {Stay with me|Come on}, {name}. {Breathe|Easy now}.
Hey. Hey, {name}. Can you hear me?
Do not move. Let me look at you.
em: Get up, {name}. I did not give you permission to lie there.
Breathe. That is an order.
bubba: Oh no no no, come on, {name}. Up you get.
Easy, easy. Bubba's here. Open your eyes.

default: What... what happened? {You helped me|You stopped}.
I thought I was done for. Thank you.
I can stand. I think. Thank you.
toEm: You... picked me up? Thank you.
I will not forget this, I swear it.
toBubba: Bubba? You got me up. Grazie.
Big man. You saved my neck.

default: {You look like you need this|Here}. {item}, on me.
Take the edge off, {name}. {item}.
I know that look. Here, {item}.
em: {item}. I know what you want. Do not make a habit of asking me.
Here. Mortals and their wants.
bubba: Eh, I know how it is. Take the {item}.
Here, darlin'. Just this once, hm?

default: Oh, {thank you|you are a saint}. I needed that.
That is... yes. {Thank you|Much better}.
I will pay you back. {Some day|I promise}.
toEm: From you? I will take it. Thank you.
You understand. Thank you.
toBubba: Grazie. I was going out of my mind.

default: {name}, the {substance}... it is eating you alive. {Will you try to cut down|Let us talk about it}?
I care what happens to you. The {substance} has to stop.
You are better than the {substance}, {name}. Try, for me.
em: The {substance} is making you small, {name}. I prefer you large. Stop.
I have watched empires fall to less. Put the {substance} down.
bubba: Listen, guaglio'. The {substance}, it takes and takes. Ease off, for me.
My cousin went down that road with {substance}. Do not follow him.

default: {You are right|Maybe you are right}. I will try. I will really try.
Nobody ever said it to my face. Alright. I will cut down.
I know. I know. I will try.
toEm: If you say so, then... I will try.
You are right. I will try, I swear.
toBubba: Alright, alright. For you, Bubba. I will try.
You sound like my father. Fine. I will cut down.

default: {Mind your own business|Who asked you}.
I have it under control. Leave it.
You do not know anything about it.
toEm: Even you do not get to tell me that.
Goddess or not, leave it alone.

default: {name}, we have a place in {place}. {It is yours|Stay there}, for as long as you need.
Nobody should sleep outside. There is a room for you in {place}.
We own a home in {place}. Take it. Please.
em: I own a house in {place}. You will live in it. That is not a request.
A roof, {name}. In {place}. You are welcome.
bubba: We got a house in {place}, darlin'. Mi casa, capisci?
Come stay at ours in {place}. The door sticks, I will fix it.

default: A roof? A real one? {Thank you|I do not know what to say}.
I will look after it like it was mine. Thank you.
I had stopped hoping. Thank you.
toEm: Under your roof? I am honoured. Thank you.
I will keep it spotless, I swear.
toBubba: Bubba, you are an angel. Grazie.
I will not get in your way. Thank you.

default: {Fancy|How about} a game of {game}, {name}?
I bet I can beat you at {game}.
You and me, {name}. {game}. {Now|Right now}.
em: {game}. You and me. I will be gracious in victory.
Play {game} with me, {name}. I am bored.
bubba: Eh, {name}! A little {game}? Friendly, friendly.
Come on, {game}, just the two of us.

default: {You are on|Alright, you asked for it}.
Sure, {why not|I could use the fun}.
Oh, I love {game}. Let us go.
toEm: Against you? I will try not to embarrass myself.
An honour. I will not go easy.
toBubba: Hah, alright Bubba. Let us see it.

default: {Not now|Some other time}.
I am not in the mood for {game}.
No thanks, {name}.
toEm: Not today. Forgive me.
I would rather not, if it is all the same.

default: {Well played|Good game}. You got me.
Hah, fair and square. Again sometime?
You are better than you look.
toEm: Of course you won. Well played.
I should have known better. Good game.
toBubba: You got me, Bubba. Good game.
Beaten by a mechanic. Well played.

default: {Better luck next time|Not bad, not bad}.
Hah! {Mine|That one is mine}.
You gave it a go. Good game.
toEm: I... won? Against you? Good game.
Forgive me. Good game all the same.

default: Even. {We will need a rematch|Fair enough}.
Neither of us, then. Good game.
A draw. I will take it.
toEm: A draw with you is a win for me.
Even. That will do.

default: {name}, you should meet {other}. {I think you two would get on|Trust me}.
Have you ever met {other}? You would like them.
I know someone for you, {name}. {other}.
em: {other}. You and {other}. I have decided, and I am never wrong.
Meet {other}, {name}. Consider it divine intervention.
bubba: Eh, {name}, you know {other}? Nice person. Very nice.
My friend {other}, single, lovely. Just saying.

default: {other}? Alright. {Why not|I will say hello}.
You think so? I will give it a try.
Well... alright. Introduce us.
toEm: If you say we are meant to, who am I to argue?
Alright. I trust your eye.
toBubba: Fine, fine. I will meet them.

default: I do not think {other} is my type.
Thank you, but no.
I am not looking right now.
toEm: I would rather choose for myself, forgive me.
Not even you can make that work.

default: {Heard anything|What is new} lately, {name}?
Any news, {name}?
What are people saying these days?
em: Tell me what the mortals are whispering, {name}.
News. Now. Entertain me.
bubba: Eh, {name}, what is the gossip?
So, what is going on round here?

default: {They say|Word is} {a} and {b} are still at each other's throats.
The war between {a} and {b}? It is not ending any time soon.
Everyone is talking about {a} and {b}. The fighting goes on.
toEm: {a} and {b} are at war. You probably knew that.
The {a} and {b} war drags on.
toBubba: {a} and {b}, still fighting. Crazy world, Bubba.
War between {a} and {b}. Keep the camper fuelled.

default: The goblins still hold {country}. {People are scared|Nobody knows what comes next}.
I heard the Horde is dug in at {country}.
Refugees from {country} keep turning up. The Horde has it.
toEm: The Horde holds {country}. They say it would not dare cross you.
Goblins in {country}, still.
toBubba: Goblins in {country}, Bubba. Lock the camper.

default: The {power} election is in {days} days. {party} or {rival}, take your pick.
Everyone is on about the vote in {power}. {days} days to go.
It is {party} against {rival} in {power}. {days} days.
toEm: An election in {power}, in {days} days. Do you vote?
{party} or {rival}. Who would you bless?

default: {winner} won in {power}. {Some are happy|Not everyone is happy}.
Did you hear? {winner} took {power}.
The count is in: {winner}, in {power}.
toEm: {winner} won {power}. Your doing?
{winner} took {power}.

default: There is {disease} going round. {Wash your hands|Keep your distance}.
Half the town is down with {disease}, they say.
Be careful. {disease} is spreading.
toEm: {disease} is spreading. Surely not your doing.
Beware {disease}, even goddesses sneeze.
toBubba: {disease} going round, Bubba. Wash those hands.

default: {company} shares are flying. Wish I had bought some.
Everyone is buying {company}, they say.
{company} is doing well. Too well, maybe.
toEm: {company} is soaring. Did you bless it?
{company}, up and up.
toBubba: {company} is up, Bubba. Buy low, eh?

default: {company} is sinking. Somebody is losing their shirt.
I would not touch {company} right now.
{company} shares are in the gutter.
toEm: {company} is collapsing. Was it you?
{company}, down and down.

default: {Did you hear|Have you heard}? {news}
Round here, the talk is this: {news}
You will not believe it. {news}
toEm: Something happened: {news}
News for you: {news}

default: {Between you and me|Do not quote me}: {rumour}
I heard this one the other day. {rumour}
People say all sorts. {rumour}
toEm: You probably know better, but: {rumour}
They say: {rumour}

default: {Nothing much|Quiet times}, honestly.
I have not heard a thing.
Nothing worth repeating.
toEm: Nothing you do not already know.
Quiet, for once.

default: {name}, I know what you did. {crime}.
You. {crime}. {Admit it|Do not bother denying it}.
I have heard things about you, {name}. {crime}, {they say|people whisper}.
em: {crime}, {name}. I can smell it on you.
I know what you are, {name}. Guilty of {crime}. Confess.
bubba: I hate to say it, {name}, but folks say {crime}. That true?
Eh, {name}. {crime}? Tell me it ain't so.

default: {What|Excuse me}? I never did any such thing.
{crime}? Me? You have the wrong person.
That is a lie and you know it.
toEm: {crime}? Says the witch who fed the spear?
I did nothing of the kind, miss. Nothing.
toBubba: Mr. Wilson, I swear, I never did.
em: {crime}? Me? I have done worse, and none of it was that.
Wrong. I do not do {crime}. I do things with far more style.
bubba: {crime}? Me? I fix things, I don't break 'em.
Now hold on, I never did nothing like that.

default: How {dare|can} you say that to my face?
Say that again and see what happens.
{crime}? Get out of my sight.
toEm: Accuse me again, witch, and I will call the priest.
You have some nerve, miss.
toBubba: I thought better of you, Wilson.
You of all people, Wilson? Shame on you.
em: Choose your next words carefully. I remember names.
Accuse me again and you will find out what a witch does with grudges.
bubba: Hey. That ain't right to say, and you know it.
I'm gonna pretend I didn't hear that, guaglio'.

default: {I|We}... I thought we were friends.
You really think I would do {crime}?
I... do not know what to say to that.
toEm: Even you think that of me, miss?
I thought you of all people would understand.
em: You think that of me? After everything?
I am... genuinely offended. That is rare.
bubba: Aw, come on. You know me better than that.
That one hurts, darlin'. It really does.

default: {Who told you that|Where did you hear that}? That was a long time ago.
I... that is not... keep your voice down.
That was years ago. I paid for it.
toEm: How did you know? Witchcraft?
Please, miss, not so loud.
toBubba: Mr. Wilson, please. That is behind me.
I am not proud of it, Mr. Wilson.
em: That was another life. Mostly.
You have been reading things you should not.
bubba: Aw. That was a long time ago. I was young and stupid.
Keep it down, eh? I ain't that guy no more.

default: {crime}? {Ha|Hah}! Me? Have you seen me?
Oh yes, {crime}. In my spare time. Between lunch and a nap.
That is the funniest thing I have heard all week.
toEm: {crime}? Says the woman who killed a god?
Oh, that is rich, coming from you, miss.
toBubba: You had me for a second there, Mr. Wilson.
em: {crime}. How flattering. How wrong.
If I had done {crime}, you would know. Everyone would.
bubba: {crime}? Ha! Me? I can't even pick a lock.
Ha! That's a good one. You should do comedy.

default: After all the roads we have walked, you say that?
I thought you trusted me.
That hurts. Coming from you, that really hurts.
toEm: Even you, Em? I thought we were past that.
You could have just said you were angry.
toBubba: Bubba... I thought you had my back.
em: I will remember that. I remember everything.
We travel together and you say that. Noted.
bubba: That one stings, pal. It really does.
We're family on the road, and you say that?

default: Say that again, and we are done travelling together.
Watch your mouth.
You want to start this here? Fine.
toEm: Watch it, witch.
Big words, Em. Back them up.
toBubba: You are out of line, Bubba.
em: Careful. I share a camp with you. I know where you sleep.
Try that again and see what happens.
bubba: Hey. We don't talk like that in this outfit.
That ain't how we do things, and you know it.

default: {crime}? Me? Sure, and I also {fly|breathe underwater}.
Ha! You have been in the {sun|pub} too long.
toEm: {crime}? That is your department, Em.
Ha! Have you been at the potions again?
em: {crime}. Yes. Obviously. How did you guess.
I would do it with more flair.
bubba: Ha! Me? {crime}? I can barely parallel park.
Good one, pal. Real good.

default: {crime}. Did I? Maybe not in so many words. But I have thought about it.
If anyone asked, could I honestly say I never did {crime}?
I tell myself I am not the kind who would do {crime}. I tell myself a lot of things.
em: {crime}. Of all the things I have done, that is not one. Probably.
I accuse myself of {crime}. The court of one finds me insufferable.
bubba: {crime}? Nah. But I did leave that wrench in the Hendersons' sink.
Me? {crime}? I'd never. Would I?

default: {crime}. Yes. I did. And I think about it {more than I let on|most nights}.
There is no point {lying to myself|pretending}: {crime}. It was me.
em: {crime}. Guilty. I would do it again, which is the worst part.
Yes. {crime}. The spear was not my only mistake.
bubba: {crime}. Yeah. I ain't proud of it.
Ma would be ashamed. {crime}. I did it.
